item.title: Data type conversion
item.description:
Despite the dynamic typing of the language, if the type of a variable is specified explicitly, then automatic type casting is not performed. and to assign a value of an incompatible type to a variable, an explicit conversion is required.

Since symbolic type names are implementation details, an explicit conversion to a specific data type is performed by calling a function with a type name, i.e. :Bool(), :StrWide(), :Int64(), etc.
